component.name: PkgForge
component.summary: Convert and install .deb and .rpm packages on Arch Linux

description.p: PkgForge converts Debian (.deb) and Red Hat (.rpm) packages into native Arch Linux (.pkg.tar.zst) packages and installs them safely. It bundles a Tauri desktop shell with a Python sidecar that drives the conversion pipeline, compatibility checks, security scanning and package lifecycle management.

ul.li: Convert .deb and .rpm packages to native Arch packages
Compatibility and ABI checks before installation
ClamAV malware scanning and decompression-bomb protection
AUR browsing, CVE scanning and update tracking
